correctness.rationale: For the incidence monomial map of the 45 tritangent planes into 27 independent line variables, equality of 27-entry exponent signatures characterizes each binomial fiber. Exact independent integer enumeration of all multisets of tritangents finds degree-2: 1035 singleton; degree-3: 15975 singleton and 120 doubleton; degree-4: 182700 singleton and 5940 doubleton. Precisely 540 quartic doubletons are coprime; the other 5400 are distinct cubic-times-variable lifts. In a two-element coprime fiber, no lower-degree binomial multiples can connect the two monomials, so each is indispensable; all quartic relations of lower rank are cubic consequences. Independent Picard lattice reflection closure recovers one E6 orbit of size 540, seed ((0,6,12,15),(2,5,11,17)). The theorem is ONLY about minimal generators through degree 4, not full ideal generation.
